author: dvsdigger
body:
Hello I am dvsdigger I was banned this morning for team griefing  and I did not do any thing I was in a game and had reported two others for team grief. After a couple min. I seen a mod. in the chat and the griefers where still there doing it so I asked the mod if he would so something about them. while I was trying to repair a bridge one of them spleefed me and then I tryed to repair it again and that is when youngsleikh banned me. As I stated before I do not think I should be banned to protect a mods friend. Yes I truly think that is what happened. I have no video to prove my point and I do get a little wound up in game some times but most of the time it is because of splefs, griefs, spawn blockers and such. I try to work with my team and not aginst them so I get upset when other team mates hinder the game. For that I can say I am sorry and will try to control my chat or just not us it at all. I hope you will consider this and look into the situation.

Thank you for your time
dvsdigger

You wouldn't be banned for no valid reason. Do you have any more evidence?

replies.author: dvsdigger
replies.body:
No like I have stated I have no proof. I will wait my time and no longer worry about other players disrupting the game. I will simply log out if I cant enjoy the game. I feel that most of your mods. are not doing there job correctly but there is nothing I can do about that.
I have no clue what Youngsheikh seen that led to me getting banned for griefing and there is nothing on your end apparently to prove or disprove the claim so you have to stand by your employe that I understand.
thank you for your time

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

Since you have no proof to show i shall lock this appeal. The infraction will stay valid.

If you think mods are abusing their powers as mod please gather evidence that supports your claim and send that to Avicus support email.
